steps.content: With your undercover mission complete, you idly flip through a stack of Aurum Secretum booklets, listening to the technical staff's spiel as casually as if you were window shopping. Your attention drifts, pulling you toward the quieter corners of the exhibition.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The raw materials for Aurum Secretum aren't publicly disclosed? There's not even a map... So mysterious.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then let's start with an order of 50 units. Besides the resources, I'm also interested in equipment. Even if you don't sell refining equipment, surely you offer storage solutions? What about your after-sales service? Will you have a team permanently stationed in DisCity?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The price isn't a problem. Just send the receipt to this mail address, and someone will handle the reimbursement for me. Right?
You say with a beaming smile, tapping your coat pocket.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All investigation expenses during the mission will be covered?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Paradeisos will cover all operational expenses during the mission. Furthermore, your requested items have already been procured and analyzed by the Ring Research Institute.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I want the complete analysis results, not just what falls "within my authorization level."

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I believe there's a misunderstanding. The Ring Research Institute has no secrets to withhold from you on this matter. Aurum Secretum's core technology remains exclusively with Fraser. Even if we were to confiscate all the exhibits here, decryption would still be impossible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see... You actually make a pretty good search engine. Now, how about predicting where this technical collaboration between Nirvana and Fraser is headed? I'm really curious—why would they propose this partnership so suddenly, and be so pumped about it?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I don't have a deep learning module installed. The randomness of human decision-making also exceeds my computational capabilities.

steps.speaker: Option
options: You don't have it installed, or you just can't tell me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What a pity, little triangle. With just a bit more polish, you could've been the crown jewel of this entire Expo.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Based on my analysis, there is a 75% probability that you are attempting humor. Acknowledged. Ha-ha.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: For information that falls beyond your clearance level, I would either avoid mentioning it entirely or carefully redirect the conversation to minimize your frustration.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In that case, let's do some Q&A—

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Before Nightfall, Fraser had already amassed considerable wealth. In fact, half of DisCity is built with their backing, and that continues to this day.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Throughout past conflicts, they've remained neutral—if not occasionally friendly—with us. Take Fraser's involvement in last year's attack: they shared substantial intelligence with us regarding the case.

options: Are we competitors when it comes to Hypercubes?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Early on, Fraser used their established wealth to accumulate massive Hypercube reserves. Their strategic neutrality during several Outland conflicts preserved these stockpiles, giving them a competitive edge.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: According to public records, Fraser currently holds the world's second-largest stockpile of Hypercubes. Their renewed push for partnerships is likely tied to the West District mine reopening—this might significantly impact their position.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hmm... you're all so enthusiastic about Fraser. Funny, I remember you being much more careful with other Outland forces.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... it never crossed your mind that something might be off about Fraser and Nirvana working together?
You stop in your tracks, gazing firmly at Schorl as the question that's been on your mind finally spills out. In your thoughts, you recall what Elvira told you in private.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: When Stewart... when my father was still alive, he once told me about a secret society. It operates in the highest levels of society—discreet, with a wide-ranging infiltration, but loosely organized. No formal rules or common purpose... just powerful people connected in the shadows.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Its members might not stand out individually, but each of them holds invisible cards of resources and power. It could be through family ties, shared interests, personal favors, or other means. In short, their influence reaches far, and sometimes just a whisper from them can spark significant changes with ease.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Worst of all, there's never a shortage of selfish, gullible parasites just waiting to be corrupted. Father said if someone wants to cheat the system, this secret society is their perfect backdoor.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: And I believe Fraser is already in contact with them. Just now, I caught a distinct "scent"—a specific incense that only members of this society use.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Maybe I'm just overthinking this, but if there really is a connection, then Fraser's visit might not be what they claim. Please stay alert, Chief.
Faced with your question, Schorl falls silent for a moment before responding.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: There are risks, certainly. We monitor all Outland activity with equal vigilance. You've attended the security meeting yourself—you know the efforts being made by the 9th Agency and all the other departments.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: But since they extended a friendly invitation first, it would be poor diplomacy not to reciprocate. More importantly, they've been quite cooperative in sharing both technology and intelligence during our recent meetings. They've also provided substantial insights regarding the Jelena situation. At a minimum, this alliance gives us leverage against our known enemy.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: jojo

options: So that Nirvana can have what they want?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: So that greater conflicts can be avoided. These are turbulent times, and the primary threats to DisCity remain Mania and the Black Rings.
It makes a fair point, enough to earn a measure of your trust.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand the need for caution in diplomatic relations.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Adelaide Campbell—If I find him suspicious, conducting a thorough investigation shouldn't be a big deal, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I find evidence against him, can I make an arrest?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Of course, as long as you have sufficient evidence. Investigating and uncovering all discrepancies is precisely the purpose of your mission.
You watch the man in the distance as he raises his hand in greeting. You know he has been monitoring your movements, just as you have been tracking his.
You can make a good guess as to why Elvira remains fixated on the Campbell patriarch, despite never having met him in person.

Fraser's attempts to pin the Aurum Secretum leak on "Outland conspirators" fall short in the face of one undeniable truth—Jelena had infiltrated DisCity eight years ago and assumed the role of Elvira Stewart's butler. The technology had already leaked back then.
Silent for a full eight years, the enigmatic Aurum Secretum remained shrouded in obscurity until Fraser's recent extravagant promotion brought it into the spotlight.
Was there a sudden breakthrough in the Aurum Secretum technology itself? Or have recent changes in DisCity presented them with an opportunity to exploit?
While he has indeed divulged a substantial amount of information, you can't rule out the possibility that this information is intentionally provided—whether to win DisCity's trust or to mislead.
Maybe Elvira's emotions have swayed you, or perhaps it's your own intuition at play—
—There's this unsettling aura around him that instinctively repulses you.
But there's no need to share this with the little triangle. You decide to end the conversation by steering it towards a lighter topic.

options: Can I get updates on the negotiation progress with Nirvana?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Sorry, you can't.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Correction: you can, provided you consent to Nirvana receiving equivalent classified disclosures about you, including location data, private affairs, and such. I suspect that wouldn't be preferable, would it?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: While we value our trust with you deeply, Paradeisos must also honor its relationships with other key figures.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is how acceptable rules are established.
It gives quite a thorough answer.
People suddenly begin gathering around you, conveniently interrupting your "discussion."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's happening? Why are there so many people all of a sudden? Did something happen?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Oh, that's because what's about to begin over there is—
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Up next, we're off to the Expo's exclusive live auction, where you'll find so many Outland treasures! And the best part? If something steals your heart, you can take it home that very day or even place custom orders with artists from afar. Isn't that wonderfully convenient?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: You see, most of these pieces hail from ancient city-states. Beyond their striking exotic beauty, they carry centuries of cultural legacy. And that's what makes them truly priceless treasures for collectors.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Just imagine—what better way to showcase your exquisite taste than displaying one of these rare and precious Outland artifacts in your very own home?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: What's more, our Speaker, Parfait, Nirvana representatives, and a host of other VIPs are all there! With their presence and sway, today's sales are bound to be nothing short of spectacular!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: So my friends, seize the moment, don't just dream—take action! If something catches your eye, place your order right now. Don't let hesitation turn into regret!
Amidst the exhibition hall teeming with crowds, Thalia maintains a dutiful smile for the camera. However, her expression wavers as the growing throng of people pushes and jostles her from all sides.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Hey, hey, hey! Quit pushing! Get in line! Get in line—

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: These offline events are always such a pain at times like this...
